description: What Bullion Trading LLC would pay for a list of items a person wants to sell: each line a product (id, slug or URL from get_buyback_price or search_products) with a quantity, or a plain description such as "2 1965 Canadian silver dollars", "$4.40 face of 90% silver dimes" or "11 oz of .999 silver bars". Priced by the store's own rules at its posted buy-back rates (catalog price, standard coin content, or weight; descriptions are read by AI only to identify the items). Returns each line, the total, the $1,000 minimum check, and how to sell (prepaid, tracked mail-in label or walk-in). An estimate, not a locked quote. Use when the user wants to know what Bullion Trading LLC would pay for items they have (a list, a lot, or a description). Computes only; nothing is sold or sent.

items.description: Up to 20 items; each needs product or text

product.description: Product id, slug or bulliontradingllc.com/product/… URL

quantity.description: How many pieces (default 1 for a product)

text.description: Plain description of the item (metal, coin or bar, weight, year, count)
